reason: It's free and it kills the Discord-plus-reader-site juggling — one link, chat sits next to the series, and it remembers where I stopped on my phone.
objection: I don't actually know if 'private' is real — if the invite link leaks, some random is in our chat and reading our files, and there's no way for me to check that.
would_change_my_mind: A mobile reader that zooms wrong, lags, or forgets my place — one annoying night and I'm back to the old site for good.
